answer.rationale: We face simultaneous headwinds: competitive pricing pressure on SMB acquisition and declining activation/onboarding metrics. Promotional_pricing directly addresses the competitive threat and has validated effectiveness in the SMB segment (memory_73). Verification of memory_31 and memory_73 will confirm whether onboarding simplification or pricing is the stronger lever given current conditions. While activation_messaging and simplify_onboarding address the 6% and 4% declines respectively, they do not defend against active competitive displacement. Referral_incentive works well with established customers (memory_57) but does not help acquisition in a pricing war. Enterprise_sales_assist targets higher-value accounts but is orthogonal to current SMB pressure. Promotional_pricing preserves long-term revenue quality by keeping price-sensitive accounts in the funnel before they churn to competitors; it also maintains optionality to layer activation improvements in parallel. A standard_experiment scope is appropriate—large enough to detect competitive response, small enough to remain reversible.
